display_long_description:
Welcome to **Gimbap House**, a cozy cooking and restaurant management game where you make every gimbap roll with your own hands. Prepare gimbap from start to finish: place the gim, spread the rice, add fillings, roll it up, plate it, slice it, and serve it fresh to your customers.

[media]




**GROW YOUR RESTAURANT**

Earn money from each order and use it to grow your business. Unlock new gimbap recipes and drinks, purchase helpful skills and upgrades, and expand from a humble pocha to a food truck, bunsik house, downtown restaurant, and fine dining.

[media]


**UPGRADE YOUR LIFE**

Your progress continues beyond the kitchen. Upgrade your home from a small gosiwon all the way to a penthouse, and decide how to invest the money you earn.

[media]

**COOK YOUR WAY**

Use active and passive skills to make cooking smoother as business gets busier. Spread rice faster, slice more pieces at once, grab drinks from farther away, and more. Watch out for pesky flies that can interfere with your kitchen equipment!

**PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE**

Gimbap House supports 8 languages: English, French, German, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Russian, and Spanish.

[media]


Cook, serve, upgrade, and build your gimbap business one roll at a time.
